content.text: {"summary":"Professor Prompt first compares a JSON file with node:sqlite for storing bookmarks, then Captain Semicolon sets up the project and builds the bookmark API with tests on the recommended storage.","items":[{"text":"Compare JSON file vs node:sqlite for storage","assignee":"a-prof","brief":"Write a short, friendly report comparing a plain JSON file with node:sqlite for storing bookmarks. Cover how simple each is, how safe the data is if the app stops mid-save, filtering by tag, speed at small sizes, and any setup or Node version needs. End with one clear recommendation and why. Done when the report is in the Reports tray.","parallel":false,"report":true},{"text":"Set up the project and its storage","assignee":"a-semic","brief":"Set up a plain Node project with no framework, using the storage the report recommends. Add the built-in Node test runner and a simple start script. Write one line in `.project`: `run: <command>`. In CLAUDE.md under \"Project-specific rules\", note the stack, how to run it and how to test it. Done when the server starts, one small test passes, and data saved to disk is still there after a restart.","parallel":false,"report":false},{"text":"Build the bookmark API with tests","assignee":"a-semic","brief":"Add JSON endpoints to save a bookmark (url, title, tags), list bookmarks (with an optional tag filter) and delete one by id. Return clear errors for bad input, like a missing url or an unknown id. Add tests for each endpoint, the tag filter, the error cases, and data surviving a restart. Done when all tests pass and the README shows how to call each endpoint.","parallel":false,"report":false}],"feature":{"name":"Bookmark API","description":"A small JSON API to save, list (filter by tag) and delete bookmarks, stored on disk so they survive a restart.","ships":true}}
